title: Home Daycare Forms Bundle, Editable Childcare Contract, Nanny Agreement, Enrollment Form, Daily Report, Fillable PDF and Word Templates
description:
Opening a home daycare, running a childcare program or hiring a nanny? This bundle gives you the 10 forms every family signs and every day needs, so your paperwork looks professional and nothing important is forgotten.

WHO IT'S FOR
Home daycare providers, family childcare homes, preschools and babysitters, plus parents hiring a nanny.

WHAT YOU GET
10 forms, each as a fillable PDF and an editable Word file, in US Letter and A4 (2 ZIP files), plus a 2-page START HERE guide:
1. Childcare Services Agreement - schedule, fees, 7 policies (hours and late pick-up, payment, absences, illness, meals, pick-up, termination), signatures
2. Child Enrollment Form - child, both parents, emergency contacts, routines
3. Medical & Allergy Information - doctor, insurance, allergies and reactions, conditions, diet, immunizations
4. Medication Authorization - dose, times, storage, with a 10-line administration log
5. Authorized Pick-Up & Photo Release - authorized / not authorized adults, photo consent, other permissions
6. Daily Report - meals, naps, diapers / potty, activities, highlights
7. Incident and Accident Report - what happened, first aid, parent notified, follow-up
8. Weekly Attendance & Payment Log - sign in / out for 10 children, payments
9. Field Trip Permission - details, supervision, medical needs, consent
10. Nanny Agreement - schedule, pay, duties, house rules, trial period, notice

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Fillable PDF: type in the fields, save, print or email to parents
- Word version: change any wording, add your logo, hours and rates
- Warm, professional design parents trust
- Covers enrollment, safety, health and daily communication

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the ZIP for your paper size (US Letter or A4)
2. Open the Word files to add your logo, program details and fees
3. Use the fillable PDFs with free Adobe Acrobat Reader, or print them
4. Keep one folder per child with the signed forms

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download, nothing is shipped
- Fillable PDFs: free Adobe Acrobat Reader recommended
- Word files open in Microsoft Word, Google Docs or Pages
- General templates, not legal advice; licensing rules differ by state or country, check your local requirements
- For use in your own program or family, no resale
- Due to the digital nature of this product, returns are not accepted. Message me with any question!
